title: Larkfield Cash Price List: Blood Glucose Testing Supplies
content:
Larkfield's cash price for each item of the Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program, per billing unit, in USD. The same list applies on all six tiers.

| Item code | Item | Billing unit | Cash price per unit |
|---|---|---|---|
| A4253 | Blood glucose test strips | 50 strips | 18.50 |
| A4259 | Lancets | 100 lancets | 9.75 |
| A4256 | Control solution | one control solution | 8.40 |
| A4258 | Spring-powered lancing device | one device | 14.95 |
| E0607 | Home blood glucose meter | one meter | 29.99 |

The price attaches to the billing unit, so a quantity is always priced as whole units times the unit price. Hypothetical: 3 units of test strips at the cash price are 3 times 18.50, that is 55.50.
